pages.title: Virtual Monopole
pages.text: A magnet with only one pole, borrowed from the vacuum and destined to return. Real monopoles have never been found, though grand unified theories predict them. This one pushes one end of a compass needle away and never pulls the other.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Planck Mites in the Quantum Foam dropped these. Harvesting more from between Casimir plates, I found they only lasted as long as the superfluid helium kept them cold.

Made in $(item)Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Ephemeral Monopole Ore$(), in veins through the Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Planck Mite.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Magnetic Monopole, Penteract Display, Tesseract Display.
